complexity_ledger.narrative: CL-03, wave 2. THE MODEL DID NOT MOVE AND WAS NOT MEANT TO. Ticket `current/` equals `desired/`; every figure the machine-checked core above reports is inherited and says nothing about this ticket. WHAT THIS TICKET DID, and the complexity claim it makes. A regression two blind judges found by hand -- `reference_ports`'s REAL adapter can stop touching the filesystem and survive both wirings, because `ledger_lines()` is the only observer of the record the port exists to make durable -- was carried end to end into a card iteration and re-scored. `D3` moved 4, 4 -> 3, 3 on a BYTE-IDENTICAL artifact, same judge model, same architecture tag, with the instrument version as the only thing that changed. Full record: `specs/results/scorecards/close-the-loop/GOAL-loop-closes-once/CL-03/RESULT.md`. THE MEASURED ALTERNATIVES, since this ledger asks for them. Three carriers were considered for the regression and two were rejected: (a) reword D3's anchor 4, rejected because an anchor is permanent under `Changing this card` and rewording rung 4 makes 83 sealed cards incomparable over a defect in one fixture; (b) add a tenth rung, rejected for the same reason plus the epic's standing rule that the served surface must not grow; (c) rewrite D3's CAVEAT, which is what shipped, at a cost of 138 bytes paid for out of scoring rule 9's verbatim restatement of the served preamble. NET: -38 bytes served, 9 rungs unchanged. A FINDING THE CORE CANNOT EXPRESS, and it is the reason this ticket is worth reading. The version 4 judge that found the durability hole DECLINED to deduct for it: "rung 4 is unsatisfiable by any suite that does assert durability, since such a case must fail the fake. The anchor structurally rewards blindness to the property that makes the real adapter real." The instrument defect is larger than the fixture defect, it is filed as `CL-03-DF-02`, and CL-03 deliberately does not repair either -- filing a regression and carrying it into a card iteration are different acts from repairing the code, and repairing the fixture would have destroyed the subject the delta is measured on. TWO OF FOUR SEALED PREDICTIONS WERE FALSIFIED, which is the outcome this project prefers. Predictions were sealed at 2026-08-11T18:42:43Z in commit a73186d, before any judge agent was launched.

refinement.detail: Searched, found none, and the reason is that CL-03 changes no model. The ticket's declared `model_delta_expectation` is `none expected`, and this ticket's `current/` and `desired/` are byte-identical (`diff -rq` clean), so `TlaSpecDevCli.tla` at this tip is `TlaSpecDevCli.tla` at 10cf11a. Every figure the machine-checked core above reports is inherited and describes a predecessor's model rather than this ticket's work. What CL-03 moved is the EVAL INSTRUMENT, which is out of model by design: two edits to `references/eval_scorecard.md` (a version line and a version history row), one caveat rewritten, one duplicated sentence removed, plus `tier_split_of`/`index` re-keyed on the full judge model id in `score_tools.py`. The refinement question -- is there a smaller representation carrying the same behavior -- was asked of the one surface this epic actually measures, `serve | wc -c`, AND IT WAS ANSWERED QUANTITATIVELY: the served surface FELL from 6,319 bytes to 6,281 with the rung count held at 9. The carrier chosen for the regression was the CHEAPEST of the three considered -- a caveat rather than a new anchor or a reworded one -- because an anchor is permanent under the card's own change rule.

ticket.objective: THE LOOP'S INPUT ALREADY EXISTS AND NOTHING CONSUMES IT. Two blind judges, in two different tickets, independently found that reference_ports's REAL adapter can stop touching the filesystem and survive both wirings -- a genuine architectural regression, found by hand, FILED ZERO TIMES, under twenty-two D3 = 4 cards. Sweep the judges' notes across the sealed record and FILE WHAT THEY FOUND, starting with the FileJournal durability hole. Then CLOSE THE LOOP ONCE, END TO END: regression -> card iteration -> architectural delta -> re-score. That artifact is the transferable thing and it has never been produced. Also declare the version-4 era boundary, and key judge tier on the FULL MODEL ID -- RM-04 found four judge models sitting under two tier labels, which confounds every tier claim in the record. DO NOT MANUFACTURE A REGRESSION: if the FileJournal hole is not real, SAY SO. And DO NOT FIX the regression -- filing it, carrying it into a card iteration and measuring the delta are different acts from repairing the code.
